heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date Concerning Trading Desks Using the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式を用いるトレーディング・デスクに係る承認を適用日前に申請・承認でき、適用日に承認されたものとみなす。
summary_en: Approval for trading desks using the internal model approach may be applied for and granted before the Application Date and is deemed granted on that date.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 249-4 of the New Public Notice, apply for approval concerning trading desks using the internal model approach (meaning the internal model approach prescribed in Article 1, item (xii-2) of the New Public Notice; the same applies in the following Article).

Where an application has been made pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may grant approval in accordance with Article 249-4, paragraph (1) of the New Public Notice. In this case, that approval is deemed to have been granted on the Application Date pursuant to that paragraph.
